title: Add 8-directional resize system and premium Tailwind design to designer
body:
## Designer Component Drag and Resize Feature - Code Review Fixes ✅

### Fixed Issues from Code Review

#### 1. Type Safety (Canvas.tsx line 209, 273)
- ✅ Fixed `schema.type` to use resizing node's type via `currentNode.type`
- ✅ Changed `findNodeInSchema` from `any` types to proper `SchemaNode` types
- ✅ Added type guards for safe array iteration

#### 2. Unused Variable (Canvas.tsx lines 235-251)
- ✅ Removed unused `newClassName` variable
- ✅ Removed aggressive className filtering logic
- ✅ Simplified to only update style object

#### 3. Cursor Logic (Canvas.tsx line 483)
- ✅ Fixed diagonal resize cursor directions
- ✅ Added proper ne/sw → nesw-resize
- ✅ Added proper nw/se → nwse-resize
- ✅ Falls back to ew-resize or ns-resize for edges

#### 4. Documentation (DRAG_AND_RESIZE_GUIDE.md line 347)
- ✅ Removed contradictory undo/redo from future enhancements
- ✅ Feature is already implemented and working

#### 5. Accessibility (ComponentPalette.tsx lines 143-144)
- ✅ Added `aria-label` to component cards with resizable status
- ✅ Added `aria-hidden="true"` to decorative badge
- ✅ Screen readers now announce "ComponentName (resizable)"

### All Review Comments Addressed ✅

**Changes Summary:**
- Type-safe implementation throughout
- Proper cursor feedback for diagonal resize
- Accessible component palette
- Clean, maintainable code
- Accurate documentation

**Tests:** All existing tests still passing ✅
